The present card endeavours to represent all the above conceptions. Yet no true image is possible in so intricate a matter.
II. THE HIGH PRIESTESS
This card is referred to the letter Gimel, which means a Camel. (The symbolism of the Camel is explained later.)
The card refers to the Moon. The Moon (being the general feminine symbol, the symbol of the deepest recesses of consciousness),
